name: signal-flow-v1
selection: First 128 positions in the existing training bank, with its exact fixed D4 views; first 32 for cotangents. Same positions/orientations across seeds. No new sampling search or validation access.
visual_probe: Native complete state tapes for actual current-board input and neutral gray eyes, holding the same 84 nonvisual context features fixed. Report absolute response and centered across-position variation; neutral context/image combinations can be out of distribution.
fitted_decoder: For trained cores only, use the already completed scaled-linear ridge-.01 residual from motor-convergence-v1. Its normalization, centering, coefficients and original-logit residual are unchanged. No fitted decoder is transferred to the initial core.
adjoint: FP64 analytical chain rule at native hard-rate state tapes, using independently reconstructed FP32 weights and leaks. Supply matching pooled cotangents through the existing native embedding VJP; compare all edge/type/input/readout-gain gradients before interpreting flow. This is a diagnostic, not a new learner implementation or update qualification.

native_comparison.scope: Same elementwise gradient tolerances as existing CPU qualification; report every discrepancy, norm and relative L2 error. Preserve failures; do not change learner precision or tolerance to pass.

reachability: Directed visual-sensor distance and reverse motor distance, truncated at K-1=7 synaptic hops. A visual-sensitive edge can lie on an allowed path only if d_eye(src)+1+d_motor(dst)<=7. Being on such a path is not proof of functional visual influence.
scope: Read-only mechanism audit on three existing initial/trained cores and fixed training positions. No topology, input, propagation, parameters, optimizer or sampler changes. No new decoder fits, loss-based selection, final-test examples, playing-strength claims or TPU initialization. Measure signal transfer before registering a propagation intervention.
